player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci ñaareelu {num_rounds} bu IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Ci beneen weer, takk ndawte bu digaale ak {min_guess} ak {max_guess}.
Ci ñaar ñaar takk, kilifaay bi mooy (2/3)x(ndawte bu ñaar ñaar takk),
ba jàngoro ji takk ji gën a jege kilifaay bi moo ko ñangul ci weer woowa.
Dónde ci sa takk ci mbindiin '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wàll bu baaxul; nga jébbal sa xalaat ni [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Xam ne dafa war a nekk diggante {min_guess} ak {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Jàngoro 0 takk na {guess0}; Jàngoro 1 takk na {guess1}. Kon kilifaay bi mooy: {target}.
message.round_win: Jëfandikukat {winner} moo ci jël xeew bi!

outcome.p0_wins: Jëfandikukat 0 moo jël ay wërsëg yu ëpp.
outcome.draw: Ci lu mat sëkk, xeex bi dafa yem.
